top_story.headline: No new FEC correspondence filings since this morning's edition
top_story.dek: All 87 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported earlier today.
paragraphs: Every Request for Additional Information (FRQ) and Form 99 filing the FEC API returned for October 3 through October 6 had already been listed in this morning's edition, so nothing is repeated here. The mechanical keyword scan flagged four October 5 Requests for Additional Information (the committees with unusual names and the University of Alabama entry), but each hit was only the standard boilerplate warning about penalties for materially false statements, not an allegation of fraud.

sections.headline: No new filings to report
paragraphs: No Request for Additional Information or Form 99 filing surfaced in the window that was not already covered in this morning's edition.
